claims.quote: Hemiancistrus landoni Eigenmann, 1916. Type locality: Naranjito, Ecuador. Maximum size 210 mm SL. Temperature 24–28°C.
Hemiancistrus landoni is distributed throughout the Guayas, Arenillas, Puyango and Zaracay rivers on the Pacific slope of Ecuador.
